card.name: Ending of Merck and Roche
card.fires_on: The final piece of the company names Merck ("ck" after Mer) and Roche ("che" after Ro), in lists of manufacturers or marketing-exclusivity notes.

modes.label: Merck
modes.description: The ending "ck" completing Merck before & Co. or Sharp & Dohme.
